segments.name: Warehousing and logistics
products: transportation of merchandise to U.S. warehouses
warehouse management and order fulfillment services
segments.description: Provides one-stop warehousing and logistics services, including customs brokerage and order fulfillment, to cross-border e-commerce merchants selling into the U.S.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers, mainly cross-border e-commerce merchants, pay service and delivery fees for warehousing, customs brokerage, transportation and order fulfillment.
revenueModel.evidence: Considering the large volume of merchandise we process, we are able to offer relatively inexpensive service fees and affordable delivery fees.
